Thank you for reaching out to Helix Bank. It's important to note that while your credit score doesn't directly affect the interest rate for personal loans at Helix Bank, other factors such as the loan amount, your employment status, income, and credit history (though not through a credit score check) can influence the interest rate and terms of your loan.

To ensure you receive the most accurate and up-to-date information, I recommend reviewing the details of our personal loan products on our website or contacting our customer service team at 1-800-HELIX-CS. They can provide you with specific information tailored to your situation.

If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!<|im_end|>
